_comment: HP08: Academic | Skill | Mastery — Makerspace, evaluating/creating bloom, expert scored
badge_description: Students who have demonstrated mastery of Makerspace equipment and can mentor peers in its use. This credential recognizes expert-level skill and the ability to lead and teach others.
intended_audience: Advanced NJIT students with demonstrated equipment proficiency
earning_criteria_text: Students must demonstrate mastery through an expert-scored capstone evaluation. The Makerspace faculty advisor assesses the student's ability to independently lead, mentor, and teach other students in safe equipment use. Evaluation includes peer coaching and a capstone project.
